title: Stud cutting and notching.
officialText:
In exterior walls and bearing partitions, any wood stud is permitted to be cut or notched to a depth
not exceeding 25 percent of its width. Cutting or notching of studs to a depth not greater than 40 percent of the width of the stud is
permitted in nonload-bearing partitions supporting no loads other than the weight of the partition.
